examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Navigation Page Layout
examples.description: This example demonstrates the layout of a navigation page, including the title bar (title), menu bar (menus), content area, and toolbar (toolbarConfiguration).

examples.title: Example 2: Using NavPathStack APIs
examples.description: This example demonstrates the use of methods in NavPathStack and route interception.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting an Interactive Transition Animation
examples.description: This sample demonstrates how to set a custom transition animation and an interactive transition animation for each NavDestination page.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing a Navigation Component with Parameter Returning
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the APIs in NavPathStack to pass parameters back to the previous page.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Background Color and Blur Effect
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the background color and background blur effect for the title bar of the home page in Navigation, as well as for the toolbar and the title bars on the NavDestination pages.

examples.title: Example 6: Obtaining the Outer Stack for a Nested Navigation Component
examples.description: This example shows how to obtain the parent NavPathStack for a nested Navigation component.

examples.title: Example 7: Obtaining the Stack Through onReady
examples.description:
This example demonstrates the following:
The routing stack operation can be conducted even when NavPathStack is not declared as a state variable.
NavDestination can obtain the corresponding NavPathInfo and its belonging NavPathStack via the onReady event.

examples.title: Example 8: Using NavDestination Lifecycle Callbacks
examples.description: This example demonstrates the timing of the NavDestination component lifecycle callbacks: onAppear, onDisAppear, onShown, onHidden, onWillAppear, onWillDisappear, onWillShow, and onWillHide.

examples.title: Example 9: Configuring the Title Bar Stack Layout
examples.description: This example demonstrates the stack layout of the title bar in the Navigation component.

examples.title: Example 10: Defining a Derived Class of NavPathStack
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to define a derived class of NavPathStack and the basic usage of the derived class in Navigation.

examples.title: Example 11: Using Symbol Icons
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the Symbol components in Navigation and NavDestination.

examples.title: Example 12: Setting the Custom Title Bar Margin
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set custom title bar padding in Navigation and NavDestination, and how to modify the main title and subtitle text styles through TextModifier.

examples.title: Example 13: Implementing a Custom Transition Animation
examples.description: This example shows how to implement a custom transition animation for navigation between pages.

examples.title: Example 14: Setting the Navigation Split-Column Mode
examples.description:
This example demonstrates the effect of the Navigation component in the split-column mode. The splitPlaceholder attribute is used to set the default placeholder page on the right side of the split column, the navBarWidthRange attribute is used to configure the width range of the navigation bar, and the divider attribute is used to customize the style of the divider between the navigation bar and the content area.
The splitPlaceholder attribute is added since API version 20, and the divider attribute is added since API version 23.
Before running this example, you need to set orientation to auto_rotation in the abilities field of the project configuration file module.json5.

examples.title: Example 15: Enabling and Disabling Navigation Toolbar Adaptation
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to enable and disable the self-adaptation capability of the navigation toolbar using the enableToolBarAdaptation attribute.
The enableToolBarAdaptation attribute is added since API version 19.
In the module.json5 file, set orientation to landscape in the abilities field. (This configuration is used only to demonstrate the toolbar adaptation capability of Navigation in landscape mode. You can set orientation to auto_rotation as required.)

examples.title: Example 16: Using NavDestination as a Navigation Page in Navigation
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to configure the homeDestination parameter to implement the NavDestination root navigation page effect of the Navigation component.
This new way to create the Navigation component is added since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 17: Using New Navigation Controller APIs
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to implement route interception by setting the setInterception method and obtain mode using the NavDestinationContext object.
The interception API is added to the NavigationInterception parameter type of setInterception since API version 22.

examples.title: Example 18: Setting Navigation as Recoverable
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set Navigation as recoverable by using the recoverable API. You need to enable the UIAbility backup and restore function during module initialization. For details, see UIAbility Backup and Restore.
The recoverable API is supported since API version 14.
